publicContractBoundary.policy: Only exact deterministic re-projections of generator/public-contract.json; private keys remain forbidden everywhere else.

derivation: Recursive leaf/container decisions against explicit public paths, closed model schema keys and listed public product-operation fields. Every AST event, control action, checkpoint and expected-state object is visited. Schema-colliding key names are documented separately; no authoring subtree is exempt. Reserved private identifiers remain covered.
